jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single separate modular pixel-avatar clothing layer. Input 1 is the approved character STYLE, proportions and frontal standing pose reference. Deliberate coarse pixel art, dark stair-step outline, 3–5 restrained tonal values, broad readable pixel clusters. No character, skin, head, hands, background, mannequin, text, logos or other garments. Entire item centered on square canvas with generous margins. Genuine transparent RGBA background and transparent openings, not a painted checkerboard. This image will become a 128×128 aligned full-canvas production layer. Create ONLY an open anthracite charcoal tailored suit jacket, notched lapels, two-button single-breasted design worn fully OPEN, two restrained flap pockets, long sleeves relaxed down at the sides following the reference arms. Smooth fine wool represented with clean broad pixel shading. Keep the complete middle TRANSPARENT from neck opening to hem; no shirt, tie, vest or dark lining filling the middle. Narrow tailored but relaxed modern silhouette, hip-length hem, cuffs at reference wrists. Jacket charcoal color is fixed.
